fundamental_objective: PROTECT — wildlife have sufficient core habitat
performance_measure: Protected land: today's protected areas are locked in and every plan protects 30% of Y2Y
in_the_analysis: The budget: 30% of the region, including the 15% already protected

performance_measure: Climate refugia: refugial residence time (1 / backward climate velocity), 2071–2100, two emission futures
source: AdaptWest 2023, CMIP6 backward climate velocity (8-GCM ensemble)
in_the_analysis: Core-habitat theme: 25% of the objective in the balanced position; the two futures (SSP2-4.5, SSP5-8.5) are separate value positions

source: Theobald et al., global human modification (gHM v3)
in_the_analysis: In every formulation at its baseline weight; it cannot move the answer — disclosed, not a driver

performance_measure: Mammal richness (species per km², area-of-habitat maps, all species)
source: Lumbierres et al., AOH species richness (mammals)
in_the_analysis: Biodiversity theme: 25% (balanced); the two layers weighted equally

performance_measure: Bird richness (species per km², area-of-habitat maps, all species)
source: Lumbierres et al., AOH species richness (birds)

performance_measure: Presence of 20 ecosystem functional groups (curated from 40 under the input pre-screen, rule R0)
source: IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology, indicative maps (Keith et al. 2022)
in_the_analysis: A representation floor, not a weighted theme: rarity-scaled targets of 10–50% per class, rarity judged in the region + 250 km

fundamental_objective: CONNECT — wildlife corridors connect core habitats
in_the_analysis: Connectivity theme: 25% (balanced); the two layers weighted equally

performance_measure: Habitat connectivity: transboundary omnidirectional current density
source: Pither et al. 2023 / O'Brien et al. (transboundary extension)

fundamental_objective: ADDRESS CLIMATE CHANGE — keep carbon out of the air
in_the_analysis: Carbon theme: 25% (balanced); the two pools split 74 / 26 by mass
Security target: 33% of the regional total (55% in the carbon-forward position)
Communities and water were not flushed out in the objectives hierarchy; the 30% area budget stands in for cost
